page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Centred text block at top, a woodcut vignette in the middle, imprint at the foot. Left margin carries handwritten shelfmarks or reference numbers, not printed text.
page.notes: Woodcut vignette below the central text: an oval landscape with rocks, trees and a figure at the top, in a decorative border with putti at the corners. No text in it. Handwritten numbers in the left margin (for example 496, 294, 373, 400, 466, 467) are manuscript annotations and are not transcribed. The initial letters DISPOSITIONEM and BARTHOLOMÆO are decorated capitals.
